ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  This document discloses an inter-se transfer of 7.19% of Aakash Exploration Services Limited shares from promoter Pravin Vershibhai Haria to promoter Navinchandra Vershibhai Haria, effective August 27, 2026. This significant shift consolidates 7.19% of the company's equity under Navinchandra's direct ownership via a gift (without consideration), effectively eliminating Pravin's individual stake within the promoter group. The transaction is compliant with SEBI (SAST) Regulations, specifically exempting it from an open offer as an internal promoter group transfer, with no apparent red flags based on the provided text.
